title: Chapter 654
text:
Blue Star, Black Star City.

Three years ago, the Mutation Disaster had ended, and the various financial groups had followed in the footsteps of Black Star to invest in Blue Star, which was Floating Dragon's territory in name. With the influx of galactic knowledge, the technological bottleneck that had existed for a long time was easily broken, and the stagnant civilization welcomed a period of rapid development.

The Mutation Disaster was both a calamity and a turning point for the civilization to become a galactic civilization. No one had forgotten the significance of what Han Xiao had done to this planet. In order to commemorate this event that had changed the fate of this planet, Bennett had taken the lead to build a large city with the Black Phantom Sanctuary as the original location and named it Han Xiao.

It was Black Star City.

The survivors that had been sheltered by the Sanctuary had become residents, and countless people from the Six Nations had moved to this city. Now, the young Black Star City had become the largest city in Blue Star. In the center of the city was the base of the Black Star Corps. The tall obelisk pointed straight to the sky, and the huge Black Star logo was engraved on the body of the tower. The height of the building decreased from the center to the edge, and suspended electric bridges crisscrossed in the air. Maglev trains shuttled back and forth, and the lights were bright, day and night.

The financial groups had come because of the name of Black Star and Floating Dragon. Black Star City had received the most investment, and the technology in the city was the highest in Blue Star. Compared to Black Star City, the capitals of the Six Nations were like villages. Black Star City was undoubtedly the 'future city' of Blue Star.

Although the treaty set by the three Universal Civilizations included the rule that they could not interfere with the progress of low-level civilizations, it was mainly to protect the low-level civilizations from being harmed. If it was to support the development of low-level civilizations, as long as the civilizations in the area did not interfere, no one would pursue the matter. Godora naturally would not stop Han Xiao from transforming his hometown.

Under the protection of Han Xiao, the Six Nations rested, developed technology, supported the people, and restored the environment. Compared to three years ago, Blue Star had changed greatly. Under Han Xiao's instructions, Bennett had also changed the characteristics of the organization and formed a new government. With Black Star City as the capital, they had become the seventh country in the world and were gradually developing toward a galactic civilization.

Stephanie and the others landed in the wilderness outside of Black Star City and looked at the city in the distance.

"This is Black Star's headquarters. According to the information we've gathered, he places a lot of importance on his mother planet.

He's investment, "a member said.

Stephanie heard this and slowly nodded.

After coming to the Shattered Star Ring, she was not in a hurry to take action. Instead, she collected information for a period of time, planned before taking action, and understood the mess that Albert had left behind.

The experts that Albert had captured had all been rescued by Black Star, and they had established a connection with each other. If she acted rashly, as long as she captured one of them, she would alert the others and let them know that someone had started hunting them again. Albert's failure made it difficult for Stephanie's operation.

Stephanie did not plan to build a base like Albert. She decided to hide in the dark and not stay for long.

Although the efficiency was a little low, her whereabouts were unpredictable. The enemy was in the light while she was in the dark, so the risk was not high.

She also did not plan to cooperate with Klent again. Klent had taken the blame for them, so the possibility of them betraying them was very high. Furthermore, if she did not build a base, the intelligence channel was not that important to her.

Under such circumstances, Black Star, who was not to be messed with, was the best first target. He had killed six of Albert's people and saved everyone else, making Albert's years of accumulation go up in smoke. Recently, he had even earned the title of a Beyond Grade A seed. He had a lot of potential and was the best prey. His Excellency Thousand Shadows would definitely like him.

"Black Star is participating in the war, so we don't have a good chance to do anything. However, as long as an enemy that he can't deal with appears on his mother planet, he'll definitely come back to deal with it. I'm not as reckless as Albert. I won't take advantage of the situation."

Stephanie did not want to attack Black Star's territory, nor did she want to take the risk of entering the secret war. She chose to set a trap and lure Black Star into an ambush. Choosing the Blue Star as the battlefield seemed to give Black Star an advantage, but in reality, it would make him cautious.

Including herself, ten Calamity Grade 'shadows' might not be able to kill Black Star, who was nicknamed 'Indestructible Body', but subduing him would not be a problem.

"Even if he has the potential to become a Beyond Grade A, he's still not a Beyond Grade A yet …" Stephanie had a calm expression.

Looking at the blue sky, Stephanie took a deep breath of air and felt the coolness in her lungs. She closed her eyes in enjoyment and said with a half-smile, "Hehe, I didn't expect to miss the entire war era after sleeping. This place is like my hometown, a thriving planet … I really want to smash it."

The other nine looked at each other and did not say anything.

They were not familiar with Stephanie. They only knew that this captain was a 'shadow' from a different era.

…

Whoosh!

The Blacklight Stealth slowly landed on an uninhabited planet. Han Xiao, Desoro, and the other three walked out of the hatch.

"Let's do it here. The place is big enough, so there's no need to worry about damage." Han Xiao smiled.

He did not choose the base as the location for the spar. If they were Calamity Grades, the base would be destroyed if they accidentally released any shockwaves. The walls of the training room might not be able to withstand the shockwaves, so he did not want to suffer any unnecessary losses.

Desoro did not say anything but expressed his attitude with his actions. He opened his arms, and golden magic circuits appeared on his black robe. His magic power surged out, and his robe fluttered in the wind as if a typhoon had appeared out of nowhere. His eyes under the shadow of the hood flashed with lightning and thunder, and his battle intent spread rapidly in the air.

Lagi and the other two Forbidden Sorcerers retreated far away and cleared the battlefield.

A sense of pressure rushed toward him, and Han Xiao's eyes narrowed. He activated the necklace with his Mechanical Force, and a brand-new mechanical suit instantly covered his entire body. It was even more beautiful than the Berserk Ape, with a streamlined silver and black body with glowing blue cloud patterns. It had turned from an iron-headed doll into a psychedelic wind.

However, it was far more violent than the Berserk Ape.

This was the upgraded version of the Berserk Ape. It was also an ape model of the 'Super Nano Transforming Mechanical Suit', named [Mountain Ape]!

The equipment requirement for the Berserk Ape was level 135, while the equipment requirement for the Mountain Ape was level 165. It was a full 30 levels increase. Han Xiao had used a large amount of rare materials and integrated new technology to greatly increase the mechanical suit's attributes.

Its armor value was over 110,000, and its power level was close to 5,000. Its performance was extremely strong.

The specialty of the Berserk Ape was its strength, while the specialty of the Mountain Ape was its energy, which was the advantage of the psionic reactor. The Berserk Ape was more for close-range combat, while the Mountain Ape fought with psionic energy. It was more versatile.

"Come!"

Desoro raised his voice. A gem that was fixed with an instant-cast spell on his collar shone brightly. The next moment, a dazzling spell array extended from under his feet, turning into a huge black whirlpool of stars that seemed to be connected to another dimension.

An enormous twelve-fingered palm reached out from the vortex. Its texture was like obsidian, and it was covered in glowing golden cracks. Just the palm alone was more than a hundred meters long, and it slammed onto the ground.

Bang!

The ground cracked, and the mountains shook!

"Summoner? Super Magic Colossus? "Han Xiao raised his eyebrows, intrigued.

The Summoner class was as famous as the Army Style. The Forbidden Sorcerers were all Secret Spell Masters and knew spells from many different classes. It seemed like Desoro's major was the Summoner class.

You want to use a large-scale Summoning spell in front of me? Do you think I'm invisible? I won't sit by and watch you summon a pig trotter!

Han Xiao curled his lips and crossed his palms, forming an oval area. He aimed at Desoro, who was not far away. A blue light particle was born in his palm and suddenly expanded, releasing a dazzling light. A majestic blue light beam shot out!

Desoro maintained the summoning circle. The patterns on his robe lit up, and a high-energy magic shield appeared in front of him. The blue light beam crashed into it. At this moment, Desoro was alarmed. His eyes narrowed, and he immediately deactivated the summoning circle, retreating a few hundred meters with a Blink spell.

Boom!

The blue light beam instantly swallowed the magic shield and shot into the ground. The ground cracked rapidly, and blue energy spewed out of the cracks.

Rumble!

A dark blue pillar of light that had expanded dozens of times erupted from the ground and soared into the sky like a fountain. The momentum was like an earth dragon turning over, and the earth was completely devoured by the energy!

Psionic Impact — Whale Wave!

One of the Mountain Ape's abilities!

The energy beam disappeared into the sky, and the ground had turned into a circular crater with a diameter of more than a hundred meters. Because the summoning circle had ended prematurely, only one arm of the Magic Colossus was summoned, and it was almost shattered by this attack.

"You know how to use psionic energy?"

Desoro's tone became extremely solemn.

A Mechanic who could use psionic energy and a Mechanic who could not were two completely different concepts!

"Isn't this —"

Han Xiao was only halfway through his sentence when his body suddenly blurred. The thruster filled with psionic energy turned him into a bolt of lightning with a blue afterimage. Han Xiao closed in on Desoro in the blink of an eye, and his fist, which was wrapped in a psionic shield, landed on Desoro's protective spiritual light along with the second half of his sentence!

"Sooner or later?!"

Bang!

The two figures collided with each other!

The psionic shield released a huge amount of kinetic energy, and the protective light shattered inch by inch!

Desoro suffered a heavy blow. His chest felt suffocated, and he was sent flying like a meteor. Han Xiao caught up to his flying figure, grabbed Desoro's neck with both hands, and threw him into the sky.

Mountain Ape Throw!

Compared to Berserk Ape's [Berserk Throw], the Mountain Ape version of Throw increased the Strength attribute by fifty points, but it reduced the number of times it could deal damage. However, there was an additional 0.5-second stun time. Overall, it was more of a control type.

Kill!

Han Xiao's figure came to a stop. The two-handed mechanical suit turned into energy cannons, and dozens of cannons were aimed at Desoro in the sky.

Tong tong tong!

In the blink of an eye, psionic cannons rushed out of the cannons and caught up to Desoro. The light illuminated his shocked eyes.

Rumble!

Balls of blue light exploded in midair!

The light from the explosions illuminated the Mountain Ape's mechanical suit helmet time and time again, and the scorching heat waves reverberated.

Under the helmet, Han Xiao's lips curled up slightly.

The weakness of a Mage was also to attack!

Swoosh!

Light flashed in the sky, and Desoro flashed out of the attack range again. He was covered in wounds and looked rather pathetic. Without saying anything, he started to cast spells. He was an elite Mage under Austin, after all. Although he was in a passive position, he would not be defeated so easily.

However, Desoro had to admit that although he did not underestimate Black Star, Black Star's combat ability was still beyond his expectations.

Swoosh swoosh swoosh …

The light of summoning flashed, and one strange summoned creature after another quickly descended. Desoro even cast dozens of instant buff spells on himself to prevent Han Xiao from attacking again. However, he found that Han Xiao had no intention of stopping his summoning.

Han Xiao chuckled and clapped his hands. The space around him suddenly rippled, and a buzzing sound echoed.

"Shaking people? I can do it too! "

Hum!

Twenty-two Army Boxes appeared out of thin air with a flash of [Dimensional Warp].

In order to increase the efficiency of the army, Han Xiao did not care about the cost and equipped the Army Boxes with energy furnaces and warp engines. This way, the support range and speed of the Mech Legion greatly increased, and there was no need for the Blacklight Stealth to be airdropped.

Most importantly … the level of the army had suddenly increased!

Finding these people to spar was not only for the Promotion mission but also to test the combat ability of the new army. Naturally, he would use everything he had.

Han Xiao pulled his fist, and Mechanical Force Chain Lightning grabbed onto every Army Box.

Bang! Bang! Bang!

The Army Boxes shook, and the doors opened one after another, spitting out countless compressed orbs and turning into a black mass of Mech Legion.

In front of the huge Mech Legion, Desoro's summoned creatures were like lambs surrounded by wolves, weak and helpless.

"Get him!" Han Xiao pointed at the helpless Desoro.

Boom!

The mechanical army acted brazenly and swallowed Desoro's summoned creature army like a flood that blotted out the sky.

The battle instantly turned into a gang fight!

The scene instantly became chaotic.
